page_title: FRE 1-3 EIN | Freiburg v Eintracht Frankfurt 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The free kick picks out Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar.
90+7' Freiburg are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
90+6' It's a yellow card for Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+5' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
90+3' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
90' Freiburg have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
89' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
89' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Hugo Ekitike will be replaced by Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' Substitution. Ansgar Knauff walks off the pitch and Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
88' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Noah Atubolu thwarted him with a fabulous save.
86' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
83' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Ellyes Skhiri is unable to continue due to injury, Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
82' Substitution. Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Merlin Rohl.
81' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
81' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
77' The ratio of the ball possession is 59:41.
74' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Jordy Makengo and he is replaced by Christian Gunter (Freiburg).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) for Junior Adamu.
72' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
72' The current number of shots on goal is 1:5.
66' Here is a change. Max Rosenfelder is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
66' Substitution. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) on for Fares Chaibi.
63' 1 - 3 Goal! Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:3.
61' 1 - 2 Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
60' The referee blows his whistle, Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a corner kick.
58' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
56' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Eintracht Frankfurt! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Benjamin Brand and both teams have no complaints.
49' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Eintracht Frankfurt! Let's see what he decides.
47' That looked a certain handball by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
46' The whistle blows and Benjamin Brand starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
45+6' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

45+4' 1 - 1 Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Noah Atubolu is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
45+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Eintracht Frankfurt.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Freiburg get a corner.
45' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Freiburg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
42' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
41' 50:50 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
38' The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
38' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

37' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Noah Atubolu makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
33' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.

33' Noah Atubolu was forced into action to thwart Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
32' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) sends a chip pass into the box, but Kevin Trapp is quickest to intercept the ball.
27' 1 - 0 That's a GOAL! The long throw is precisely headed on by Matthias Ginter to teammate Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), who coolly slots home from close range. It's now 1:0.
25' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
18' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
18' The free kick is taken by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), but ball is cleared.
16' There's an opportunity for Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
12' Freiburg are ruled offside.
12' A cross from a corner kick by Freiburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
12' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' The game is interrupted now, Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' One of the players from Freiburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' The free kick from long range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
